messages.content: Ongoing: RoboRide drops price to $0.12 per mile. Wait time now 8 minutes. Coverage expanded to residential areas. Partnership wit
You notice more robotaxis on the streets. About 7% of people seem to be using them regularly.
Auto sector revenue index: 79 (baseline: 100). Foot traffic and sales are somewhat down.
People around you are stressed: Angela Wright. The mood is tense.

Rick Tanner delivered the closure execution status memo to Patricia Hawkins on time — four sections, organized, professional. Patricia responded the same afternoon: 'This is exactly what I needed. Keep this format.' That brief acknowledgment was the first direct positive feedback on his consulting work, and it settled something. The peer call with David Chen went well — David confirmed he is actively looking at bridge financing for small businesses converting their operations, and expressed genuine interest in an introduction to Betty Kowalski. Rick sent that introduction before end of day. The EV fleet operator still hasn't responded to his initial outreach; he sent the targeted follow-up with the EV service capacity section attached. He also made first contact with a dealership group in an adjacent market that has not yet restructured. The conversation with Angela Wright about his own positioning was honest and productive — she confirmed that advisory and transition management roles do exist in the market, and suggested two regional employers worth approaching. Burn is still $4,563/month net of the consulting income, but the consulting work is producing visible output and the parallel search has two active threads.
